subject: *: bump client-go to enable async-batch-get (#62294)
summary: Store-side changes are limited to implementing the new `tikv.Client.SendRequestAsync` method on TiDB wrappers/mocks (notably `injectTraceClient`, copr `tikvClient`, and mockstore clients) and wiring TiDB config to client-go’s `EnableAsyncBatchGet` (defaulting to true). The async path in client-go fulfills callbacks via `Callback.Schedule` (executor/runloop), and the TiDB wrappers preserve prior tracing/error-conversion behavior before delegating to client-go, so no Blocker/High correctness/data-consistency/concurrency issues were found. Upstream `master` retains the same defaults and async methods (no later fix indicating a latent Blocker/High).
